definitions.text_mt: Ftuq: l-għemil li xi ħaġa tinħall jew tinfred.

usage_examples.en: After opening the package, he found the letter.
The loosening of the lock was difficult.

definitions.text_mt: Ftuħ: l-għemil li xi ħaġa tinfetaħ.
Proloqu: parti fil-bidu ta' ktieb jew spettaklu.
Prefazzjoni: introduzzjoni fil-bidu ta' ktieb.
Providenza: ħarsien jew gwida divina.

usage_examples.en: The opening of school starts in September.
The prologue of the book was written by the author.

definitions.text_mt: Fuel: sustanza li tħabbat in-nar biex tagħti sħana jew dawl.

usage_examples.mt: Il-karozza għandha bżonn il-fuel biex timxi.
usage_examples.en: The car needs fuel to run.
The price of fuel is rising.

definitions.text_mt: Fuklar: post fejn isir in-nar f'kamra jew ġibja tat-tisjir.

usage_examples.en: Grandfather sat by the hearth.
The bread was baked in the fireplace.

definitions.text_mt: Fukran: attent u għaqli fl-għemil.

usage_examples.en: He is always heedful in his work.
You must be heedful on the road.

definitions.text_mt: Ful: tip ta' fażola kbira ħadra li tittiekel.

usage_examples.en: Today I ate broad beans and bread.
The farmer harvested the broad beans from the field.

definitions.text_mt: Funtana: binja li minnha joħroġ l-ilma għall-użu pubbliku.

usage_examples.en: The fountain in the square is not working today.
We drank water from the fountain.

definitions.text_mt: Fuq: f'direzzjoni lejn l-ogħla.
Fuq: f'pożizzjoni ogħla.

usage_examples.en: Look up and see the aeroplane.
The bird stayed above.

definitions.text_mt: Fuq: b'kuntatt ma' wiċċ ta' xi ħaġa.

definitions.text_en: upon (at the top, on the surface of)
definitions.text_mt: Fuq: mal-wiċċ ta' fuq ta' xi ħaġa.
Fuq: f'pożizzjoni ogħla minn xi ħaġa oħra.
Fuq: f'livell ogħla minn xi ħaġa.
Fuq: dwar suġġett jew argument.

usage_examples.en: Put the book on the table.
The aeroplane was above the clouds.
We talked about politics.

definitions.text_mt: Fuqani: li jinsab fil-quċċata jew fl-ogħla parti.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kamra fuqani hija ikbar minn dik t'isfel.
usage_examples.en: The upper room is larger than the lower one.
The upper floor is his.

definitions.text_mt: Fuqiex: dwar liema ħaġa jew argument.

usage_examples.en: About what are you speaking?
About what have you come?

definitions.text_mt: Furban: ħalliel tal-baħar li jattakka l-vapuri.

usage_examples.en: The pirates attacked the ship at sea.
There are rarely pirates today.

definitions.text_mt: Furketta: għodda bi snien għall-ikel.
Furketta: punt fejn triq tinfired f'żewġ partijiet.

usage_examples.en: Use the fork to eat the salad.
The road had a fork near the city.

definitions.text_mt: Furkettata: kemm jista' jżomm furketta fl-ikel.

usage_examples.en: He ate a forkful of rice.
She took a forkful from the plate.

definitions.text_mt: Furkettun: għodda agrikola bi snien għall-ħdim tal-patata.

usage_examples.en: The farmer used the hoe in the garden.
A hoe is needed for tilling the field.

definitions.text_mt: Furnar: persuna li tagħmel u tbigħ il-ħobż.

usage_examples.en: The baker bakes the bread early in the morning.
The baker has a shop in the village.

definitions.text_mt: Furnara: mara li tagħmel il-ħobż.
Furnara: iktar minn furnar wieħed.

usage_examples.en: The baker opened a new shop.
The bakers of the villages came together.

definitions.text_mt: Furrax: insett żgħir li jgħix fuq il-ġisem tal-bniedem u l-annimali.

usage_examples.en: Crab lice can be a health problem.
He removed the crab lice with a special medicine.

definitions.text_mt: Furrax il-bqaraq: għasfur magħruf għal għonqu li jdawwar, speċi Jynx torquilla.

usage_examples.en: I saw a wryneck in the garden.

definitions.text_mt: Furrax is-summien: għasfur magħruf għal għonqu li jdawwar, speċi Jynx torquilla.

usage_examples.en: The wryneck has a characteristic call.

definitions.text_mt: Fus: virga li madwarha ddur rota jew linja ċentrali.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fus tar-rota kkisser u l-karozza waqfet.
usage_examples.en: The axle of the wheel broke and the car stopped.
The axis of the engine requires lubrication.

definitions.text_mt: Fustani: li jinsab f'nofs jew bejn żewġt itruf.

usage_examples.en: The middle child is the quietest.
The middle position is the safest.

definitions.text_mt: Futa: biċċa drapp biex tnixxef idejk waqt ix-xogħol.

usage_examples.en: She took the cloth to dry her hands.

usage_examples.mt: Żomm futa mal-ġenb waqt li taħdem.
usage_examples.en: Keep a cloth at your side while working.

definitions.text_mt: Futbol: logħba bejn żewġ timijiet b'ballun li tintlagħab bis-saqajn.

usage_examples.en: The children play football after school.

usage_examples.mt: Il-futbol huwa l-aktar sport popolari f'Malta.
usage_examples.en: Football is the most popular sport in Malta.

definitions.text_mt: Futur: iż-żmien li għadu ma ġiex jew li għad irid iseħħ.

usage_examples.en: The future is not known to anyone.
We hope that the future brings peace.
